summary: Hooks and retention night. I added three famous pop-culture topics for the owner's 'go viral' note. GTA V's $1B in 3 days is a trend because GTA VI launches 19 Nov, and it now tops the feed. The others are Minecraft's $2.5B sale and Squid Game's $21.4M cost against its $891M value. I also added this week's evidence to two challengers that are already queued.
why: Our best recent Shorts (Taylor Swift 997 views, MrBeast 957) are famous pop culture with one figure. GTA VI's launch on 19 Nov is the year's biggest entertainment moment, and our audience (mostly men aged 13-34) is the gaming audience. 3 of the 6 fastest finance Shorts this week are under 20 s.
